title: Subgraph discrepancies in the complete graph
summary: Given a 2-edge-coloring $f : E(K_n) \rightarrow \{\pm 1\}$, the discrepancy of a subgraph $F \subseteq K_n$ is defined as $\left| \sum_{e \in E(F)} f(e) \right|$. Erdős, Füredi, Loebl and Sós showed that if $F$ is an $n$-vertex tree with maximum degree at most $(1-\varepsilon)n$, then every 2-coloring of $K_n$ has a copy of $F$ with discrepancy $Ω(\varepsilon)n$. We extend this result by showing that the same conclusion holds for every $n$-vertex graph with maximum degree at most $(1-\varepsilon)n$ and no isolated vertices.
